items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I went on with Duke Jackson. I stayed with him from September until February.

ctx.x: See? Because I started out on the tuba with the music. See? And the last I played in 28, I was writing this very time here. I left Los Angeles playing tuba. And then tuba. Went on the tuba. Went on through. That's when I left the band in Chicago. That's where Johnny had all those kids and women to stay in Chicago. When the name was up on the wall, when they get out of you and get a job. But they want me to stay there. I said no man, you can't take care of me. So I had a job at St. Louis. I went on with Duke…
I was going to ask him more about that early music up in the country. Because not very many people remember much about that.
